mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bids VALUES ( seq_bid_Id.nextval, #{auctionId}, #{userId}, #{bidPrice}, 'bid', #{bidTime}, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE BIDS SET BID_STATUS = 'outbid' WHERE AUCTION_ID = #{auctionId} AND BID_STATUS = 'bid'
mapper.select: SELECT B.BID_PRICE B.BID_TIME U.user_name FROM bids B INNER JOIN USERS U ON B.USER_ID = U.ID ORDER BY B.BID_TIME DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY;
